dct_title_s: Plan for the improvement of St. Anthony Heights, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for the improvement of St. Anthony Heights park in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Twenty-sixth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis.
